about_the_game:
This is a story of tradition and technology, sacrifice and rebirth, and the struggle to protect a world on the brink of unimaginable change.

༄ For generations, Shamans have protected the balance between the physical and spiritual realms, channeling Lumina—the vital essence that flows between worlds. But this harmony has been shattered by a powerful corporation seeking to exploit and manipulate this sacred energy for its own gain.

⸺ A MAGIC WORLD

The pursuit of absolute control over Lumina has brought devastating consequences: legendary spirits, once guardians of nature, have been corrupted, and automata infused with spiritual energy now turn against their creators.

༄ As destruction spreads, Thaynara, a young Shaman descended from two great clans, awakens her rare ability and forges a pact with Uyara, a powerful Guardian Spirit who shares her mission. Together, they embark on a journey to restore balance between the realms, battling relentless foes and uncovering the hidden secrets of Lumina.

⸺ FEATURES

༄ Lumina is an action RPG that blends fast-paced combat with exploration in a world where spirituality and progress collide.

༄ Face formidable enemies in intense battles, master stylish combos, and unleash powerful abilities alongside Guardian Spirits, each with their own personality and combat style. Develop your skills, upgrade automata, and unravel the mysteries of Shamanism.

༄ Travel through breathtaking landscapes of the Spirit Zones and take on colossal foes, from rogue automata and Anima agents to the Great Legends of Folklore. Forge alliances at the Fluminense Academy of Shamanic Arts and explore Rio de Janeiro through supernatural investigation contracts.

⸺ LIVING LANDSCAPES AWAIT YOU! 

                   At the end of this journey, what will remain: hope or destruction?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-2400 (quad-core) / AMD® Ryzen™ 3 1200 (quad-core)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 750 (2 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 550 (2 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows® 10 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel® Core™ i5-7600 (quad-core) / AMD® Ryzen™ 3 2200G (quad-core)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1650 (4 GB) / AMD® Radeon™ RX 580 (4 GB)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 10 GB available space

short_description: A megacorporation threatens the balance between realms, and Thaynara, a young Shaman, forms a pact with a Guardian Spirit to stop it. Face enemies in fast-paced combat, master stylish combos, and uncover the secrets of shamanism.
